Eligibility Criteria
Users must have participated in the Vela Exchange beta and been active on the platform.
Users who generated a minimum trading volume of
$3,000+
on Vela Exchange during the beta stage are eligible.
Forex trading volume counts as
1/3
of crypto trading volume.
Trades must have remained open for at least
1 minute
.
Users can check their eligibility through the official
Vela Airdrop Page
.
